topic.readerProblem: A buyer shortlisting two AI visibility platforms, Scrunch AI and Profound, needs a verdict on which fits their team, with engines, entry price, trial terms and what each tool actually changes compared side by side.
topic.connection: Helps an AEOeye reader decide between a one-time AI visibility baseline and two ongoing platforms, and says plainly when neither is needed yet; the baseline route is AEOeye's free audit and $29 one-time report.

assessment: The page gives a verdict (Scrunch for a priced self-serve start, Profound for enterprise teams wanting agents, neither if the baseline is unknown), a vendor-sourced comparison table checked on 2026-10-03, and a corrected framing: both vendors now sell an action loop, so the real difference is what the action touches (Scrunch changes delivery to AI bots, Profound produces new assets). It replaces the earlier claim that Profound is primarily monitoring. It does not claim hands-on use, treats data-capture method and refresh rate as vendor statements, quotes no agency price for Profound because the agency tab is not in the served HTML, and labels the AEOeye benchmark as small and self-selected.

sources.supports: Scrunch Core $250/month, 125 prompts, 5,000 responses/month, four platforms; AXP not in Core; Enterprise custom with nine platforms.
Agency Core $500/month, Enterprise tiers custom, seven-day Core trial, platform lists for Core and Enterprise.
Scrunch collects through browser automation and official APIs; daily for the first 14 days then a default 72-hour refresh.
Content delivery detects AI traffic and serves optimized HTML to AI bots while people see the normal site.
Scrunch states data can be exported via CSV and API.
Scrunch states it completed a SOC 2 Type II audit and points to a trust center.
Sitecore announced the Scrunch acquisition on June 3, 2026; Scrunch recommendations to be automated inside SitecoreAI.

Profound Trial (free, 50 prompts daily for 7 days, ChatGPT/Gemini/Google AI Overviews, prompts not customizable); Enterprise custom with up to nine engines, daily tracking, exports, SSO; credits consumed per agent run; overage or pause setting; Agency Growth 400 credits per month per client workspace.

Profound captures front-end experiences rather than API outputs, runs every tracked prompt daily because AI platforms do not return the same answer twice, and lists the nine engines it queries; SOC 2 Type II statement.
Agents research what AI engines cite, draft content, include an approval step and publish to a CMS.
September 15, 2026 Series D of $180M at $1.8B valuation; over 1,000 enterprise brands (Profound's figure); evolution from analytics to AI Marketer, Agents, Ads Studio and earned-media work.
